nodes.name: L-function carrier
nodes.statement: An L-function L: a Dirichlet series with meromorphic continuation and a functional equation. The neutral substrate both zeta and Davenport-Heilbronn instantiate. Carries the typed field has_euler_product (inhabited for zeta, type False for D-H).
nodes.notes: Neutral primitive shared by zeta and D-H. The discrimination must happen above this node, never at it.

nodes.name: Functional equation / Gamma factor
nodes.statement: The completed L-function satisfies a functional equation s <-> 1-s with an archimedean Gamma factor. This is realization-layer data: D-H has it too.
nodes.notes: D-H-buildable on purpose. The FE alone does not pin zeros to the line; D-H is the witness.

nodes.name: Explicit formula / trace realization
nodes.statement: The von Mangoldt explicit formula relates a sum over zeros to a sum over prime powers. Equivalently zeta is a regularized determinant / trace (Connes, Deninger, Hesselholt over F_q). This is the realization half.
nodes.notes: The easy half. D-H has an explicit formula too, which is exactly why trace-side proofs are suspect (K1/R3.5).

nodes.name: Euler product data
nodes.statement: EulerProductData(L): a typed structure whose first field hasEuler : L.has_euler_product, carrying local states and place-dependent Frobenius bidegree (1,p). For D-H the hasEuler field has type False, so no inhabitant exists.
nodes.notes: proven_lean (formation-only; zeta side rests on has_euler_product := True placeholder, VERIFIER #EP-1 still open). First node where D-H falls away by TYPE, not by string-matching. The K2 root. dh_buildable=false.

nodes.name: Deninger Frobenius correspondence Gamma_S
nodes.statement: The arithmetic Frobenius correspondence Gamma_S with place-dependent bidegree (1,p) (LEARNINGS #25), built only on top of Euler-product data. Its regularized self-intersection Gamma_S^2 = sum_p (log p)(...) is the von Mangoldt prime sum (#26).
nodes.notes: Requires Euler product => no Frobenius for D-H. The correspondence is the cycle whose positivity is RH.

nodes.name: Arithmetic Frobenius algebra A
nodes.statement: The place-graded R-algebra A generated by Gamma_S over Spec(Z), scale p in the p-block, with the von Mangoldt diagonal. The arithmetic analogue of End^0(Jac C) tensor R.
nodes.notes: No Euler product => no Frobenius => no algebra A to polarize for D-H. Core object of the bespoke system.

nodes.name: Rosati-type involution dagger
nodes.statement: A polarization-induced adjoint dagger on A with the trace form B(x,y)=Tr(x y^dagger). For Frobenius pi: pi^dagger = conjugate, pi pi^dagger = q. The involution comes from a polarization, not from the zeros (K1-safe).
nodes.notes: The dagger must be supplied by a polarization. That polarization over Z is the open M4 content.

nodes.name: Tate-twist H^2 fundamental class
nodes.statement: FrobeniusTateTwist(L): the H^2 = C(-1) / Euler-pole fundamental class, formed ONLY after Euler-product data supplies local Frobenius bidegrees. Contains EulerProductData as a field.
nodes.notes: proven_lean (formation-only; zeta side rests on has_euler_product := True placeholder, VERIFIER #EP-1 still open). Lean: no_dh_frobeniusTateTwist. The fundamental class is the target the cup product must hit.

nodes.name: Frobenius cup target H^1 x H^1 -> H^2
nodes.statement: FrobeniusCupTarget(L): the pairing cup: H^1 -> H^1 -> H^2 with a trace to the Tate-twist fundamental class, formable only on top of the Tate twist. The object whose Hodge-Riemann polarization is the open arithmetic Hodge standard conjecture.
nodes.notes: proven_lean (formation-only; zeta side rests on has_euler_product := True placeholder, VERIFIER #EP-1 still open). Positivity intentionally absent (open M4). The structural heart of the system.

nodes.name: Arithmetic polarization exists (the open organ)
nodes.statement: AXIOM (open arithmetic content): there exists a polarization on the cup target over Spec(Z) inducing dagger such that the Rosati trace form B(x,y)=Tr(x y^dagger) is well-defined. This is the geometric source of the dagger. It is NOT positivity yet, only existence of the polarizing structure.
nodes.notes: THE exposed open axiom for the dagger. Over F_q it is the canonical polarization of Jac C (a theorem); over Z it is unidentified.

nodes.name: Arithmetic Hodge-Riemann positivity (M4)
nodes.statement: AXIOM (the deep open content = arithmetic Hodge standard conjecture): the cup form on the primitive part, equivalently B(x,y)=Tr(x y^dagger) on A tensor R, has NO negative spectrum. Over a field this is Grothendieck's Hodge standard conjecture (proven char 0 via Hodge-Riemann); over Z it is open.
nodes.notes: The single deep open axiom whose truth is RH. dh_buildable=false: no algebra to polarize for D-H. This is M4.

nodes.name: Positivity comes from polarization, not zeros (K1 discipline)
nodes.statement: AXIOM (methodological, K1): the positivity of B must be derived from the polarization (a geometric input), never read off the location of the zeros. Any certificate computed from the zeros is circular and excluded.
nodes.notes: Retagged layer signature -> foundation per adversary: it is a methodology constraint, not a signature object (like FND-rh-pi01). Enforces non-circularity. The M2.5 form was built from Gamma factor + von Mangoldt, no zeros, to honor this.

nodes.name: FF face 1: Rosati positivity (2T)
nodes.statement: For a curve C/F_q, the Rosati Gram G[a][b] = q^min(a,b) a_{|a-b|} on End^0(Jac C) tensor R has no negative eigenvalues. Verified exact across genus 1-2. This positivity IS RH for C.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field theorem, D-H has no analogue, so the flag does not apply. M1 done. The proven template the arithmetic axiom AX-hodge-riemann abstracts. g=1: G=[[2,t],[t,2q]], PD iff |t|<2sqrt(q).

nodes.name: FF face 2: primitive intersection negative-definiteness (2G)
nodes.statement: On the primitive/correspondence part of NS(C x C), the intersection form is negative-definite (Hodge index). It equals -1 times the Rosati Gram. The geometric incarnation of the same positivity.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field theorem, no D-H analogue. The sign-flipped face of 2T. Shows the polarization and the intersection form are the same object.

nodes.name: FF face 3: |alpha_i| = sqrt(q)
nodes.statement: The Frobenius eigenvalues on H^1 satisfy |alpha_i| = sqrt(q), i.e. RH for C. This is forced by Rosati positivity via pi pi^dagger = q.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field theorem, no D-H analogue. The zero-location face. Positivity => this. The function-field theorem that RH-for-zeta abstracts.

nodes.name: FF face 4: TP/flow zeros on Re(s)=1/2 (2S)
nodes.statement: Over F_q, zeta is the regularized determinant of the Frobenius flow on S^1-Tate periodic TP (Hesselholt); the cup-product split TP_odd/TP_even is the Hodge-index split, and the flow zeros sit on the critical line. Realization is proven, the signature is the same Hodge index.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field theorem, no D-H analogue. Hesselholt realization is proven over F_q; RH is still the separate signature input. Confirms the dichotomy.

nodes.name: FF four faces equivalent (Weil 1948)
nodes.statement: Over F_q the four faces are equivalent: Rosati positivity (2T) <=> primitive intersection negative-definiteness (2G) <=> |alpha_i|=sqrt(q) <=> TP/flow zeros on Re(s)=1/2 (2S). This is the proven template for the whole program.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field theorem, no D-H analogue. The equivalence the bespoke system lifts to Z. Each arithmetic node mirrors one face.

nodes.statement: not CanFormCupTarget davenport_heilbronn. D-H cannot form the cup target, because its has_euler_product field is definitionally False. Proven via cupTarget_requires_eulerProduct.

nodes.statement: CanFormCupTarget zeta_function. Zeta CAN form the cup target (formation only, no positivity). Witnessed by zetaToyCupTarget over the placeholder has_euler_product = True.
nodes.notes: proven_lean (formation-only; zeta side rests on has_euler_product := True placeholder, VERIFIER #EP-1 still open). Asymmetry made explicit: zeta forms the target, D-H cannot. Positivity of the formed target is still open.

nodes.name: M2.5/M2.6: non-circular Weil form assembled
nodes.statement: The truncated arithmetic Weil form M = A_arch + P_fin + B_pole, built from the Gamma factor and von Mangoldt primes with NO zeros used, is a genuine computable object. Archimedean block validated by T_max convergence; C_mu = log pi - psi((1+mu)/2).
nodes.notes: Buildable for any Gamma factor, including D-H (dh_buildable=true): this is the realization shadow of the form, not the polarization.

nodes.name: M2.5: min eig(M) = +0.035 > 0 for zeta
nodes.statement: min eig(A_arch + P_fin + B_pole) = +0.035 > 0 for zeta, stable across K=5..8. A non-circular positivity certificate: necessary but not sufficient, since it is a finite truncation of the target.
nodes.notes: Necessary-not-sufficient. Positive for zeta but, as M2.6 showed, also +0.094 for D-H: the certificate is non-discriminating.

nodes.name: M2.6: four-way discrimination FAILS (stealth window)
nodes.statement: The four-way verdict fails: min eig(M) is +0.035 (zeta, correct) but +0.094 (D-H, WRONG SIGN). D-H's off-line obstruction (gamma~85.7, ~2.6% of the raw spectrum) sits below the reconstruction-residual floor at reachable truncation. The soft form is blind to it.
nodes.notes: The decisive negative result: no soft/numerical certificate separates zeta from D-H. Proves M3+ must be analytic/geometric.

nodes.name: M3: composite-deletion discriminator carries no geometry
nodes.statement: Deleting P_comp gives M_euler = A_arch + P_pp + B_pole, separating controls (zeta +0.035, D-H -0.929) and surviving stress tests as a NUMERICAL discriminator. But it adds NO geometric content: for zeta P_comp=0 is the Euler product (a theorem); for D-H there is no surface, so M_euler is the trace of no object.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable flipped false -> TRUE per adversary: D-H instantiates the matrix and returns -0.929 (a finite value), so the object IS buildable on D-H; only the geometry is absent, which dh_buildable does not measure. M3 reorganized bookkeeping only. The polarization over Z remains unidentified. Marks where the genuine M4 work begins. It is NOT a load-bearing premise of M4 (downgraded to 'motivates').

nodes.name: Rosati Gram closed form (FF)
nodes.statement: G[a][b] = q^min(a,b) a_{|a-b|} with a_k = sum_i alpha_i^k = q^k + 1 - N_k. No negative eigenvalues <=> |alpha_i|=sqrt(q). Zero eigenvalues exactly when pi generates a proper subalgebra (positive semi-definite, rank = dim Q(pi)).
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field theorem, no D-H analogue. The exact matrix the arithmetic A_P truncation must reproduce as P->infinity. Genus-2/F_5 gives the semi-definite case.

nodes.name: Positivity => eigenvalues on critical line (M5 step)
nodes.statement: Given AX-hodge-riemann (B has no negative spectrum) and pi pi^dagger = q-analogue (the functional-equation pairing), the Frobenius eigenvalues / zeta zeros are forced onto Re(s)=1/2. The arithmetic lift of FF face 3.
nodes.notes: M5: the final implication from polarization positivity to zero location. Mirrors how pi pi^dagger=q forces |alpha|=sqrt(q).

nodes.statement: Verify the Rosati positivity formulation in the function-field case and its equivalence to the three other faces, including the sign-flip to the intersection form. Complete, exact, genus 1-2.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable=N/A: function-field milestone, no D-H analogue. Milestone M1, done. The proven base case of the ladder.

nodes.name: M4: arithmetic Hodge standard conjecture (the deep step)
nodes.statement: Identify the polarization (geometric source of positivity over Z), then control the P->infinity limit and prove the Rosati trace form positivity survives. This IS the arithmetic Hodge standard conjecture. The single hard open theorem.
nodes.notes: The deep step. Everything below feeds it; TGT-rh follows from it. Unbuildable for D-H by construction. M3 motivates but does not logically feed it (adversary fix).

nodes.name: Riemann Hypothesis for zeta
nodes.statement: All non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function lie on the critical line Re(s) = 1/2. Equivalently (this program): arithmetic Rosati positivity holds on the arithmetic Frobenius algebra A of Spec(Z).
nodes.notes: The single convergence node. Its only two load-bearing premises are TGT-m4-hodge-standard and LEM-pole-eigenvalue-bridge, both dh_buildable=false signature nodes (Euler-gated). FND-rh-pi01, OBS-marginal-positivity, LEM-zeta-can-form-cup are CONTEXT, not logical load (adversary fix).

nodes.name: RH is Pi^0_1 (logical calibration)
nodes.statement: RH is a Pi^0_1 arithmetic sentence, so an independence proof would itself prove RH true (undecidability is a back door, not an escape). Calibrates what a proof must achieve.
nodes.notes: Foundation-layer constraint on TGT-rh (contextualizes, not a logical premise). dh_buildable true: the logical form is generic, not zeta-specific.

nodes.name: D-H has no Euler product (the K2 root)
nodes.statement: Davenport-Heilbronn has a functional equation but no Euler product, hence no Frobenius correspondence, hence no Frobenius algebra to polarize. The signature is structurally unbuildable for the counterexample. Known off-line zero rho ~ 0.8085 + 85.699 i.
nodes.notes: The discipline's anchor. The one object unbuildable for D-H is the one whose positivity is RH. This is a FEATURE.

nodes.name: Stealth window (marginal positivity floor)
nodes.statement: D-H's off-line obstruction is ~2.6% of the raw spectrum, below any reachable reconstruction-residual floor in float64 (eps < 10^-5, looser than the Platt-Trudgian rigorous eps < 10^-7). No soft/numerical certificate from the input side separates zeta from D-H.
nodes.notes: Why M2.6 four-way fails. Forces the proof to engage exact zeta structure (analytic/geometric), not bookkeeping.

nodes.name: K1 circularity trap
nodes.statement: A trace-side positivity read off the zeros is circular: it presupposes RH. Connes/explicit-formula positivity is R3.5-circular. The polarization positivity must come from a polarization, not from the zero locations.
nodes.notes: Excludes the easy realization-side proofs. Lives at the realization layer because that is where circular certificates live.

nodes.name: Marginal-positivity thesis
nodes.statement: RH is just barely true: D-H fails Weil positivity by 78.7% per off-line direction yet the wall is tight, with zero slack. If positivity had any buffer a soft realization would close RH. It has none, so the signature is the whole content.
nodes.notes: dh_buildable flipped false -> TRUE per adversary: the 78.7% figure is computed FROM D-H (same convention as OBS-stealth-window). The structural reason realization frameworks cannot close RH. Compass pointing at Level 4 / the polarization.

nodes.name: No constructed surface over Spec(Z)
nodes.statement: There is no ambient arithmetic surface Spec(Z) x_F1 Spec(Z) carrying an intersection form. The Rosati framing avoids needing the surface to STATE the target, but the polarization still must be supplied. The surface, if it existed, would carry the Hodge index.
nodes.notes: Why M4 is hard: the geometric source of the dagger over Z is unidentified. Candidate: Arakelov/Faltings-Hriljac glued to finite places.

nodes.name: Gap property: global (on the product, reaches the zeros)
nodes.statement: The polarization lives on the global H^1 of the PRODUCT Spec(Z) x Spec(Z), carrying a Frobenius correspondence Gamma_S of bidegree (1,p) that reaches the analytically-continued zeta zeros in Re(s)<1. Not confined to a single arithmetic surface, not place-by-place: the archimedean place enters the positivity together with all finite places. Equivalently the pairing reaches the actual global zeros (the spectrum), not a local or single-factor invariant. One of the four conjuncts of TGT-m4-hodge-standard. K2-NEUTRAL (archimedean side, shared by D-H), but as a load-bearing conjunct of the gap it is gated below by the Euler/Frobenius nodes, hence dh_buildable=false.
nodes.notes: Conjunct 1 of 4 of the universal gap. PROVEN-DROPPABLE by Faltings-Hriljac (NODE-fh-too-local), which has the other three but lives on a single surface. Per #70/2LO this and carries-the-zeta-trace are one bundled datum (the product + Gamma_S) for the literal target object; they dissociate only at the bracket level (AHK is global-but-blind). dh_buildable=false: load-bearing conjunct on the path to TGT-rh, so the D-H audit requires it false.

nodes.name: Gap property: carries the arithmetic Frobenius trace t (von Mangoldt)
nodes.statement: The signed pairing's VALUE sees the arithmetic Frobenius trace t (a_k = sum alpha_i^k over F_q; the von Mangoldt prime-power data Gamma_S^2 = sum_p (log p)(...) over Z), not just the formal (1,p) bidegree. The form is NOT arithmetic-blind: distinct trace inputs give distinct signatures. It has a genuine slot into which the Frobenius trace is injected so the positivity verdict depends on it. One of the four conjuncts of TGT-m4-hodge-standard. K2-EULER side (requires the Euler product: no Euler product => no Gamma_S => no trace to carry), a genuine D-H discriminator.
nodes.notes: Conjunct 2 of 4 of the universal gap. PROVEN-DROPPABLE by AHK (NODE-ahk-too-blind), which has the other three but reads the same (1,3) signature for t=2 and t=100. Read as 'arithmetic-sensitive in general' it dissociates from global (FH has trace without global); read as 'carries the ZETA von-Mangoldt trace' it is co-dependent with global (#70/2LO). AHK's open step 'inject t into the HR form' IS this property. Petrov non-semisimplicity forbids the eigenspace injection. dh_buildable=false (Euler-gated, load-bearing).

nodes.name: Gap property: RH-equivalent, not strictly stronger
nodes.statement: The positivity of the pairing is EQUIVALENT to RH for zeta, not strictly stronger. A polarization whose positivity implies more than RH (e.g. GRH for all Dirichlet L at once) overshoots: it can be FALSE for zeta while RH is true, so its positivity is the wrong target. The form must be exactly calibrated to single-zeta RH: positive iff all zeta zeros are on the line, no more. One of the four conjuncts of TGT-m4-hodge-standard. K2-NEUTRAL (the calibration to the zero set is an archimedean/continuation property D-H also enjoys for its own zeros).
nodes.notes: Conjunct 3 of 4 of the universal gap. PROVEN-DROPPABLE by de Branges (NODE-debranges-too-strong), which has the other three but overshoots: its positivity implies GRH and Conrey-Li PROVED it fails for zeta at the 34th zero (#43, 12 sig figs). de Branges is REFUTED on this property, the one dead bracket. dh_buildable=false: load-bearing conjunct on the path to TGT-rh.

nodes.name: Gap property: non-circular, positivity from a polarization not the zeros (K1)
nodes.statement: The positivity must be DERIVED from a polarization (a geometric/combinatorial/kernel input logically prior to RH), never read off the location of the zeros. Any certificate computed from the zeros, or any trace-formula positivity that is K1-equivalent to RH with no independent reduction (R3.5 no-shortcut), is circular and excluded. A methodological/provenance property orthogonal to the three structural ones: it constrains WHERE the positivity comes from, not WHAT shape the form has. One of the four conjuncts of TGT-m4-hodge-standard. K2-EULER side (a non-circular polarization needs the Frobenius surface only the Euler product supplies).
nodes.notes: Conjunct 4 of 4 of the universal gap. ASYMMETRIC: the only conjunct with NO positive realization-candidate witness; the three structural brackets satisfy it but none realizes zeta, and it is witnessed-as-droppable only NEGATIVELY by the Connes trace-formula family (CAND-connes-1999-adele-trace, CAND-connes-eta-x-weil-form), which instantiate OBS-k1-circularity. So there is no noncircular near-miss to extend, only a wall to escape. Refines AX-noncircular-source into a gap conjunct. dh_buildable=false (load-bearing).

nodes.name: Class A no-go: the archimedean Sen module Theta cannot SOURCE the M4 polarization (compact-group + transport theorem)
nodes.statement: CONDITIONAL NO-GO (class C_A = source the M4 polarization as a Tate-equivariant invariant cup form intrinsic to the archimedean Sen operator Theta, or as the canonical CKS/monodromy-weight form on its nu-primitive graded pieces). The Tate-equivariant cup duality is Theta^T B + B Theta = -w B, i.e. Theta + (w/2)I is in so(B). COMPACT-GROUP THEOREM (proven, one line): if B is positive-definite then O(B) = O(n) is compact, so so(B) consists of B-skew (hence semisimple) operators, forcing Theta semisimple, nu = 0. Contrapositive: Petrov's non-semisimple Sen operator (nu != 0, arXiv:2302.11389, Annals) admits NO positive-definite invariant cup form. TRANSPORT THEOREM (rigorous, #68 generalized to genuine Jordan blocks): the only fallback surviving nu != 0, the CKS primitive form Q_l(x,y) = Q(x, nu^l y), has its positive factor Q as an IMPORTED input (the polarization of nearby smooth fibers of a degenerating VHS); over Spec(Z) there is no ambient polarized VHS to transport from, so supplying Q = supplying the arithmetic polarization = RH. Class A therefore re-encodes an externally-supplied polarization, it never sources one. Strictly smaller than all constructions: it excludes the Frobenius/F-half ample class (class E), which Petrov's theorem leaves untouched.

Class E = the Frobenius/F-half arithmetic ample class on the Euler-pole H^2 (the (1,p) bidegree, {log p}, Gamma_S on the product Spec(Z) x Spec(Z)) IS the universal gap TGT-m4-hodge-standard. The pincer is the program's SHARPEST COMPASS but NOT a wall around the prize: the target object STRADDLES by construction (as the F_q template does, where Gamma on C x C carries t AND the Rosati form controls all eigenvalues at once), negating H3.
